# svg-slides set: Art Deco (`deco`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

Art Deco luxe: cream paper (near-black in the dark theme), metallic gold and a deeper gold as the only two accents, jet-black / cream text, wide-tracked Georgia titles, thin double rules, stepped chevron collars, corner sunburst rays and fan (concentric arc) motifs, very restrained. Not any template's brand.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set deco --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- 1920s Art Deco poster and architecture ornament: sunburst rays, fans, stepped chevrons and double rules in gold on black or cream.
- Contemporary Art Deco presentation palettes: cream, metallic gold, deeper gold, jet.

Fonts: head `Georgia, Times New Roman, serif`; sans `Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`. Token names are palette
slots, not literal hues: `--teal` is this set's primary. `--block` / `--on-block` are the
colour-block fill and the text on it (`--ink` / `--on-ink` likewise for a reversed field). Inlined svg-library components pick up the same palette.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover: double gold frame; quarter sunbursts in the four corners; a stepped chevron collar above the centred wide-tracked title; a double rule above the meta line. |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: double frame and corner rays; the chapter number in gold, centred, over a short double rule, then eyebrow, title and orientation. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Takeaway slide: frame and corner rays; a three-step chevron collar above the centred statement; a double rule above the attribution. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Content slide: double rule under the heading; the graphic in a double-ruled gold plate; a gold bar beside the key point. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: double rule under the heading; two double-ruled gold plates, the large one for the graphic, the narrow one for the takeaway. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: the cover's frame, corner rays and chevron collar; centred title and contact lines; a double rule above the meta line. |
